ACE Dell Control uses locally installed third-party components:

1. DellFanManagement tools, version 2.1.1, by Aaron Kelley
   https://github.com/AaronKelley/DellFanManagement
   License: GPL-3.0

2. LibreHardwareMonitor, version 0.9.6
   https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor
   License: Mozilla Public License 2.0

3. bzh-windrv-dell-smm-io fan driver, by 424778940z
   https://github.com/424778940z/bzh-windrv-dell-smm-io
   License: GPL-3.0

4. PawnIO.Modules 0.2.2, embedded in LibreHardwareMonitorLib
   https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules
   License: LGPL-2.1

5. Costura.Fody 4.1.0, merged into DellFanCmd.exe
   https://github.com/Fody/Costura
   License: MIT

6. System.Memory 4.6.3, System.Buffers 4.6.1,
   System.Numerics.Vectors 4.6.1, and
   System.Runtime.CompilerServices.Unsafe 6.1.2, by Microsoft
   https://www.nuget.org/packages/System.Memory/4.6.3
   License: MIT

The original tools and their license terms remain applicable. Source snapshots
for the named projects are in the installed source folder, alongside ACE Dell
Control's application source file. The driver and tool binaries match the
official DellFanManagement 2.1.1 release assets; the archived driver source
has code unchanged since the driver's 2015 build date. Full license texts are
in the installed licenses folder. The ACE GUI itself is licensed under GPL-3.0-only (see the LICENSE file in the
source repository). This is a technical preview build.
